scope: Ordinary generic Store wrappers and ordered remove; not complete collections, iterators, String or ZUI.

identity.source_hashes: All four exact Git blob SHA256 values in the author store_stage receipt were independently recomputed and match.
identity.binding: Harness was copied and hashed before target reuse. The C allocator observer is read from the compile-time manifest path; reviewer checked its live bytes against the exact tested Git blob before and after replay. The observer supplies fault injection/counts, not compiler safety authority.

controls: Ordered remove returns the exact owning Item and restores suffix order; successful Drop trace ACB, initial reserve failure empty trace, suffix preparation failure ABC, and live allocator count zero.
A separately observed suffix-preparation failure preserves all original values, order, length and capacity. Invalid negative/end indices allocate nothing and preserve the same state.
An active Store view retained across remove rejects in Analyze or Verify, rather than failing at parse/import/type formation.

source_review: Range checks and complete suffix reservation precede any mutation. Pop/push reversal transfers each real owner once and restores order; all subsequent pushes fit already established capacity.
The implementation is ordinary source using existing Store primitives and responsibility checking; no new privileged collection opcode or host implementation is introduced.
limitations: No reviewer full target/workspace run, Clippy, native Windows or Rust cost comparison. Prior loader/UTF-8 review remains tied to its own exact snapshot.
